summary: A partial list can still produce the retinol caution. Coverage stays incomplete.

findings.explanation: Confirmed retinol is still rule-eligible on a partial list. Confirmed glycolic acid has class exfoliant. The American Academy of Dermatology caution still applies to the rows that are present.
findings.reason: A partial list does not erase a confirmed row, and it does not make the missing rows known.
limitations: Team-approved v1 rules. This is not clinically validated or a safety guarantee. Severity, when present, is display priority and not a clinical grade.
